texts.text: Arrival by escalator. UNCOMMON PHENOMENON.
texts.speaker: Overseer

texts.text: What business? Looking forward to it. WASTE DISPOSAL EXCEPTION FLAGGED.
texts.speaker: Overseer

texts.text: The owner of the voice was so enormous that we had to crane our necks to their limit merely to find his face.
You are anomalous. Objects reaching this floor don't normally arrive on an escalator. OUT-OF-RANGE ENTITIES.
texts.speaker: Overseer

texts.text: Not consistent with common sense. IDENTIFICATION REQUIRED.
texts.speaker: Overseer

texts.text: I expected Ishmael to come back with something about what counted as common sense and what didn't, but she stayed quiet. I suppose she had seen too much by this point to split hairs over semantics.
The being suddenly bent his massive body down until it was eye to eye with Ishmael.
Please remain calm. NO HOSTILE INTENT AT PRESENT.
texts.speaker: Overseer

texts.text: Its massive carapace was riddled with holes, each one holding something like a round face that stared straight at us.
The faces swiveled independently within the shell, peering every which way. The sight stirred a dread I could neither name nor shake.
... It reminds me of a Whale.
texts.speaker: Ishmael

texts.text: <... Now that you mention it, the Whale of the Porous Hand had a part that looked like this entity's carapace...>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: ... Hm. OBSERVING.
texts.speaker: Overseer

texts.text: There seems... little cause to let terror take root just yet.
texts.speaker: Yi Sang

texts.text: It may merely be indulging its curiosity.
texts.speaker: Yi Sang

texts.text: Logical cognition taking priority over desire. MANNEQUIN CLASSIFICATION UNLIKELY.
texts.speaker: Overseer

texts.text: What's a Whale?
texts.speaker: Pwie

texts.text: ... You want me to explain Whales? There's the 1-hour crash course, or the 12-hour crash lecture if you're feeling brave...
texts.speaker: Ishmael

texts.text: That was a joke. I'll give you chapter and verse another time. Another time...
texts.speaker: Ishmael

texts.text: When is "another time"?
texts.speaker: Pwie

texts.text: Are there no Whales here in the department store?
texts.speaker: Pwie

texts.text: Understood. Understanding verified. OBSERVATION CLOSED.
texts.speaker: Overseer

texts.text: You carry... a fragrance. The scent of a customer of high Prestige...
texts.speaker: Overseer

texts.text: ... PRIORITY HOSPITALITY REQUIRED.
texts.speaker: Overseer

texts.text: <Maybe it just smells a fat wallet...>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: Looking for a particular hide? Coming all the way down to the "bottom" means you're in a rush, yes? RUSH ORDER. SURCHARGE REQUIRED.
texts.speaker: Overseer

texts.text: We require—
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: Understood. You require bespoke attire.
texts.speaker: Overseer

texts.text: Intended wearer... confirmed.
texts.speaker: Overseer

texts.text: The being bent lower still, bringing its face level not with any of us... but with Pwie.
Accompanying customers are temporary entities expected to return upstairs. LONG-TERM RESIDENCY IMPROBABLE. STRANGER CLASSIFICATION CONFIRMED.
texts.speaker: Overseer

texts.text: I am curious as to the nature of the strangers' existence. To return a lost being to their original position: the strangers' lot? NEW QUERY FORMED.
texts.speaker: Overseer

texts.text: Even we who bear our existence cannot say where its compass truly points...
texts.speaker: Yi Sang

texts.text: Then... are you the one who can make the outfit? We have a budget, but we are not exactly made of eyeballs, so... we can't pay much.
texts.speaker: Ishmael

texts.text: Eyeballs are incidental. The material is what is important.
texts.speaker: Overseer

texts.text: A Golden Hide garment requires a large amount of Golden Hide, but we have none left. STOCK DEPLETED.
texts.speaker: Overseer

texts.text: ... We used to receive many premium commissions like this. Those were the exciting days. DISAPPOINTMENT EXPRESSED.
texts.speaker: Overseer

texts.text: There used to be a lot?
texts.speaker: Pwie

texts.text: Indeed. It was so many seasons ago that I barely remember... but this floor once held a great deal of Golden Hide. AGE OF ABUNDANCE.
texts.speaker: Overseer

texts.text: Where did all of it go?
texts.speaker: Pwie

texts.text: Scattered throughout the department store. Every corner.
texts.speaker: Overseer

texts.text: You can't seriously mean we have to search every nook and cranny of the department store ourselves.
texts.speaker: Ishmael

texts.text: Of course not. No customer could search the entire department store. It is always changing and returning.
texts.speaker: Overseer

texts.text: Hmm...
texts.speaker: Yi Sang

texts.text: Perhaps... you, too, wish to behold such a work with your own eyes? A Golden Hide garment woven from many sheets of Golden Hide.
texts.speaker: Yi Sang

texts.text: For an inquiring soul with a passion for the sartorial arts, such a desire would be only natural...
texts.speaker: Yi Sang

texts.text: Hm. The proposal has merit. Golden Hide garments have been absent for many seasons and may never be available again. REGRET AND ANTICIPATION INTERSECT.
texts.speaker: Overseer

texts.text: Moreover, one possessing your seasoned eye... should surely know which Golden Hides must be gathered... would you not?
texts.speaker: Yi Sang

texts.text: Are you not a professional who spent a lifetime in this trade, with hide ever beneath your hands?
texts.speaker: Yi Sang

texts.text: I like how you call me a "professional." AMBITION DRIVE STIMULATED.
texts.speaker: Overseer

texts.text: I will scan the department store's remaining Golden Hides and determine the specimens required for this commission.
texts.speaker: Overseer

texts.text: That's a relief. For a moment, I thought we had to wander around this whole place forever...
texts.speaker: Ishmael

texts.text: Hrrrngh...!
texts.speaker: Overseer

texts.text: At the entity's cry of exertion, several of the faces embedded across the carapace vanished at once.
I can see it... TARGET LOCKED.
texts.speaker: Overseer

texts.text: Golden Hides the customers must gather. Golden Hides we must fashion. Golden Hides that slipped from our hands...
texts.speaker: Overseer

texts.text: Every one of them is located. TRAIL CONFIRMED.
texts.speaker: Overseer

texts.text: Completion requires Golden Hides to intersect the customers' prior routes. PUZZLE PIECED.
texts.speaker: Overseer

texts.text: Their task apparently complete, the vanished faces slid back into their individual sockets across the carapace.
I will tell you the location of the Hides. You can remember things, can't you? DOUBTING STRANGERS' INTELLIGENCE.
texts.speaker: Overseer

texts.text: List the locations. I will remember them.
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: In that case...
texts.speaker: Overseer

texts.text: The being recited the complete list of Golden Hides we would have to obtain.
So... the Golden Hide has to come from someone we've already met or passed along the way?
texts.speaker: Ishmael

texts.text: Yes, that is the crucial part. A bespoke garment must be made from Hides touched by the customers or marked by their passage.
texts.speaker: Overseer

texts.text: Some among those listed... seem unlikely to part with their Golden Hide without a struggle.
texts.speaker: Yi Sang

texts.text: That problem is for the strangers to overcome. The Golden Hide is a valuable resource obtained through conquest in this department store. ARDUOUS JOURNEY ANTICIPATED.
texts.speaker: Overseer

texts.text: Bring every Golden Hide I named, and my children will make the garment. WORKLOAD DIVISION.
texts.speaker: Overseer

texts.text: In any case, thanks... This is a lot of help without asking for anything. Everyone upstairs was obsessed with eyeballs, you know...
texts.speaker: Ishmael

texts.text: Of course, the eyeballs are a separate matter. UPDATE LEDGER.
texts.speaker: Overseer

texts.text: Ledger updated!
texts.speaker: Scraper

texts.text: Uh-huh... Right.
texts.speaker: Ishmael

texts.text: Nothing in the world comes without a price tag. Even here, in the confines of this department store...
texts.speaker: Yi Sang

texts.text: There used to be more hideworkers—more hides to go around. Now only the retired ones are left. Business is so tight that we scrape meat from leftover rawhide and sell it by the scrap.
texts.speaker: Scraper

texts.text: It seems a thorny road lies ahead.
texts.speaker: Yi Sang

texts.text: *sigh* No way around it, I guess.
texts.speaker: Ishmael

texts.text: You're sighing. Sigh is for hard times.
texts.speaker: Pwie

texts.text: Making clothes must be hard, then.
texts.speaker: Pwie

texts.text: Perhaps it is simply that young Pwie's garment is uniquely difficult to make...
texts.speaker: Yi Sang

texts.text: Why?
texts.speaker: Pwie

texts.text: Is it because I'm... both noble and abominable in this department store?
texts.speaker: Pwie

texts.text: Hmm... more like "special," I'd say.
texts.speaker: Ishmael

texts.text: You don't worship me, and you don't find me disgusting.
texts.speaker: Pwie

texts.text: You don't ask me for eyeballs. Instead, you pay eyeballs to buy me things.
texts.speaker: Pwie

texts.text: That's why you're strange.
texts.speaker: Pwie

texts.text: Even now, you're sighing... But you're still trying to make clothes for me.
texts.speaker: Pwie

texts.text: Just as malice is not always born of reason, kindness need not be weighed upon a merchant's scale.
texts.speaker: Yi Sang

texts.text: Consider this, Pwie: you, too, care for this bug—
texts.speaker: Yi Sang

texts.text: It's not "bug." It's "Wriggley."
texts.speaker: Pwie

texts.text: M-my apologies. You, too, care for Wriggley enough to spare it from pain, do you not? Yet Wriggley has paid no price for such tenderness.
texts.speaker: Yi Sang

texts.text: That's... because...
texts.speaker: Pwie

texts.text: ... I dunno how to explain it.
texts.speaker: Pwie

texts.text: Then perhaps we are much the same in that regard. Language often fails where the heart has already chosen.
texts.speaker: Yi Sang

texts.text: <I'm feeling a bit conflicted.>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: May I ask why, Manager?
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: <The truth is, we...>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: <On the surface, it looks as though we're making these clothes entirely for Pwie's sake, but...>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: Yes. Strictly speaking, our objective is not aimed at altruism, but at producing a different outcome from the previous one.
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: <Right. But Pwie doesn't know that.>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: Even if we told Pwie, the entity would not comprehend the full premise.
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: <I know, but... it still feels awful, like we're deceiving Pwie without meaning to.>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: The entity we call "Pwie" can exist only here, as you are already aware. It cannot exist outside the Grand Magasin.
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: <I know... But what about all the talking and time we spent together? We have a real connection with them now.>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: It's a dilemma that has no answer. Dwelling on such feelings will only worsen your distress, Manager.
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: <... Probably. Still... I don't want to look away from what I'm feeling...>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: ... Understood.
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: Processing completed.
texts.speaker: Overseer

texts.text: This is the tannery. It processes various treatments to leather to prevent it from rotting.
texts.speaker: Tannery

texts.text: ... When, after placing my hand over the leather handrail of an escalator... the speed of the railing exactly matches my own...
texts.speaker: Nurturer

texts.text: The upper-tier customers returned with every required Golden Hide. AMAZEMENT AND COMPLIMENTS.
texts.speaker: Overseer

texts.text: I bore no part in the gathering... I shall kindly relay that praise at the feet of those who carried the burden.
texts.speaker: Yi Sang

texts.text: Now you can make the Golden Hide outfit, right?
texts.speaker: Ishmael

texts.text: Golden Hide couture cannot be produced at the snap of a finger. CUSTOMER COMMON SENSE DEFICIENT.
texts.speaker: Overseer

texts.text: You mean collecting the materials was not the only errand?
texts.speaker: Ishmael

texts.text: Have the customers never commissioned bespoke clothing? INCOMPREHENSION RISING.
texts.speaker: Overseer

texts.text: ... No, we haven't. Do you have any idea how much a single bespoke suit costs inside a Nest?
texts.speaker: Ishmael

texts.text: ... Customers appear less affluent than they initially appeared. STATUS DOWNGRADED.
texts.speaker: Overseer

texts.text: ... He appears to grow more candid with each word traded...
texts.speaker: Yi Sang

texts.text: All hides pass through processing stages. Process observation. The first step is to get their size. PRACTICAL MEASUREMENTS PRIORITIZED.
texts.speaker: Overseer

texts.text: Tanner performs the fittings. You can find her in the room over there. KINDLY DIRECTED.
texts.speaker: Overseer

texts.text: A pleasure to have you, strangers.
texts.speaker: Tanner

texts.text: You have come to commission a bespoke garment of Golden Hide, yes?
texts.speaker: Tanner

texts.text: May I ask who will be wearing it?
texts.speaker: Tanner

texts.text: This child.
texts.speaker: Yi Sang

texts.text: We build the garment around the body itself, correcting every flaw and letting every strength take the stage. Ready-to-wear is merely a compromise cut by the dozen.
texts.speaker: Tanner

texts.text: Now, which type of lapel suits your preference? Notched? Peak? Semi-peak? Or perhaps fish mouth?
texts.speaker: Tanner

texts.text: What are tho—
texts.speaker: Pwie

texts.text: <Nope, nope! Time out! It's gonna take all day at this rate. Let's skip the lecture and get to crafting.>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: Use your judgment. We'll leave it to you.
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: ...! My judgment...! That means... tailor-made...!
texts.speaker: Tanner

texts.text: Very well. I will put every talent I possess to the needle and leave no detail wanting.
texts.speaker: Tanner

texts.text: Now, the measurements. This way, please.
texts.speaker: Tanner

texts.text: With a series of dazzling flourishes, the Tanner sent the measuring tape spinning around Pwie and began taking their measurements.
Measure Wriggley too.
texts.speaker: Pwie

texts.text: As you wish.
texts.speaker: Tanner

texts.text: ... I understand now. It would seem, dear customer, all that's left for you...
texts.speaker: Tanner

texts.text: ... is to grow into the garment... and beyond.
texts.speaker: Tanner

texts.text: ... Mhm.
texts.speaker: Pwie

texts.text: You will have your hands full from here on.
texts.speaker: Tanner

texts.text: Whenever hide this valuable enters processing... rude scraps gather, hoping to make a quick fortune out of it.
texts.speaker: Tanner

texts.text: Offcuts from hides that were never properly tanned...
texts.speaker: Tanner

texts.text: Keep them from laying so much as a finger on the work, please.
texts.speaker: Tanner

texts.text: <Meursault! We've got company closing in from every direction!>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: Acknowledged, Manager.
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: There. It is done.
texts.speaker: Tanner

texts.text: Quite a crowd gathered for today's fitting.
texts.speaker: Tanner

texts.text: Though we did naught but follow behind... the press of bodies seemed to steal the breath from us.
texts.speaker: Yi Sang

texts.text: We don't have to do this for every single stage of the process, do we?
texts.speaker: Ishmael

texts.text: The pattern is complete. One pass beneath the needle, with some stitching and cutting, and the garment will be finished.
texts.speaker: Tanner

texts.text: Head to the Cutting Room and start up the machine. And keep an eye out for customers who are after the hide. They can get... a bit violent.
texts.speaker: Tanner

texts.text: Once all the pieces are cut, take them outside and have the Nurturer stitch them up.
texts.speaker: Tanner

texts.text: <This must be the cutting machine.>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: Activating the device now, Manager.
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: ...! Something's coming.
texts.speaker: Ishmael

texts.text: Gold... Gold... Golden Hide... Want... the Hide...
texts.speaker: Crawling Leather

texts.text: They appear to covet the Golden Hide we are processing...
texts.speaker: Yi Sang

texts.text: <Let's keep them away until the machine's done with the processing.>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: We were told the Golden Hide garment could be sewn here...
texts.speaker: Yi Sang

texts.text: ... The sharp thrilling sound when cloth goes into a hot sewing machine. The feeling of peeling the film off a new purchase in one long riiiiip. The satisfying clean pull when a receipt tears exactly along the dotted line...
texts.speaker: Nurturer

texts.text: ... What sort of game are we playing now?
texts.speaker: Ishmael

texts.text: Game? I wanna play, too.
texts.speaker: Pwie

texts.text: I'm listing thoughts that make the mind purr just by imagining them...
texts.speaker: Nurturer

texts.text: The damp, slippery feeling whenever I touch Wriggley.
texts.speaker: Pwie

texts.text: Looking ahead and knowing there is someone I can follow.
texts.speaker: Pwie

texts.text: What I feel when the one whose chains rattle looks back to check that I'm still following.
texts.speaker: Pwie

texts.text: <... You really did that?>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: Yes.
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: Watching everyone sigh and complain... then still gather materials because the clothes are for me.
texts.speaker: Pwie

texts.text: Mmm... yes. All feel-good thoughts, yours.
texts.speaker: Nurturer

texts.text: Thinking about them makes me feel good. I'll sew the Golden Hide into your clothes while it lasts.
texts.speaker: Nurturer

texts.text: *slurp* *smack*
texts.speaker: Nurturer

texts.text: ... That's what passes as sewing here?
texts.speaker: Ishmael

texts.text: Miss Ishmael, every person... nay, every employee of this department store must have their own technique of sewing...
texts.speaker: Yi Sang

texts.text: *lick* *smack* *slurp*
texts.speaker: Nurturer

texts.text: More are coming. They want my clothes.
texts.speaker: Pwie

texts.text: But aren't those... the Rouges?
texts.speaker: Ishmael

texts.text: Rouges blinded by the sunlight.
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: What has so enthralled them that they would assail even the being they intend to exalt?
texts.speaker: Yi Sang

texts.text: Their blindness keeps them from discerning what must be done.
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: <All yours again, Meursault.>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: Understood.
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: There... almost done. One final material and it will be complete.
texts.speaker: Nurturer

texts.text: Do you have any idea how many laps we've made around this department store for materials? I wasn't there for every run, sure, but still...
texts.speaker: Ishmael

texts.text: Aw... My mood's worsened now... But you already have... the material you need...
texts.speaker: Nurturer

texts.text: Oh, we do? Well, why didn't you start with that—
texts.speaker: Ishmael

texts.text: The Golden Cocoon.
texts.speaker: Nurturer

texts.text: The Golden Cocoon must be wrung for its extract, which will be used to paint over the garment. Eight good twists should squeeze out nearly everything inside.
texts.speaker: Nurturer

texts.text: Then what becomes of Wrigg—no, the cocoon?
texts.speaker: Yi Sang

texts.text: Its work as a cocoon will be finished, and only the husk will remain. Still, an empty shell should feel pleasant to touch, heh heh... Soft and limp...
texts.speaker: Nurturer

texts.text: There has to be another way. A substitute material, maybe, or another process...
texts.speaker: Ishmael

texts.text: Anything, as long as the Cocoon can be included in the outfit... Becoming one with it should work, too. Meaning, the wearer can simply... gulp it down.
texts.speaker: Nurturer

texts.text: Uh...
texts.speaker: Ishmael

texts.text: ... Is Wriggley going to die?
texts.speaker: Pwie

texts.text: Yes.
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: Because of my new clothing?
texts.speaker: Pwie

texts.text: ... Correct.
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: Then... I don't want it anymore.
texts.speaker: Pwie

texts.text: Oh no... We only have the last step to go through, though. No one will feel good if you stop now.
texts.speaker: Nurturer

texts.text: ... I don't want it!
texts.speaker: Pwie

texts.text: Pwie lunged forward and snatched the cocoon floating above Meursault's shoulder.
They cradled Wriggley in both hands and glared at the Nurturer as though he were about to come for the cocoon.
Nobody can force you if you really don't want the clothes... But you need the garment to enter the fifth floor, don't you?
texts.speaker: Ishmael

texts.text: Are you all right with not going up?
texts.speaker: Ishmael

texts.text: That... that can't happen either...
texts.speaker: Pwie

texts.text: If I don't go up... I'll let everyone down. I won't be able to make my voice heard... I won't be able to move forward...
texts.speaker: Pwie

texts.text: The purpose I was born for... the thing I'm supposed to be... what everyone expects from me... everyone who got extinguished because of me...
texts.speaker: Pwie

texts.text: ... You must be deeply troubled. This fork in the road is far too cruel for any child to choose.
texts.speaker: Yi Sang

texts.text: <... Let's return to B1. Scouring through the Shore may be a needle-in-a-haystack job, but we might be able to find another living larva that still has its cocoon.>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: The probability is low.
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: But Pwie cares for it so much. I don't know, asking a child to kill it is just...
texts.speaker: Ishmael

texts.text: It may be rare, but there has to be one more somewhere. We can keep looking.
texts.speaker: Ishmael

texts.text: All right, then. Let's head back up, Pwie.
texts.speaker: Ishmael

texts.text: ... No, I can't stay downstairs. I'm... I was born because... I'm supposed to... I...
texts.speaker: Pwie

texts.text: I can't put this off anymore.
texts.speaker: Pwie

texts.text: Pwie...?
texts.speaker: Yi Sang

texts.text: Have to fill. Empty. Began empty... Not enough. There's nothing. Have to fill.
texts.speaker: Pwie

texts.text: Pwie, what are you saying? You're not making sense. Are you not feeling well or...
texts.speaker: Ishmael

texts.text: Pwie folded in on themselves, trembling violently against the floor.
The voice that escaped them sounded equally terrified and entranced, as though they'd been possessed by something.
That reaction, that trembling slick with naked desire... It's a lot like... that raw, unfiltered appetite I'd felt through Don Quixote.
<Pwie, wait. Give Wriggley back to Meursault first...!>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: Hungry.... I'm so hungry...
texts.speaker: Pwie

texts.text: *screeeeeee*
texts.speaker: Cocoon

texts.text: ... Ghhh!!
texts.speaker: Pwie

texts.text: <... It's too late.>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: Overtaken by the hunger and greed they must've never felt before,
Pwie tore into the cocoon they had cherished, swallowing it in frantic mouthfuls before anyone could intervene.
All we could do... was stand there and watch.
Hey... We've seen this before, haven't we? It's that same craving for...
texts.speaker: Ishmael

texts.text: ... There might have been warning signs.
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: The Rouges have been consuming the department store to the point of depletion.
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: <And Pwie... kept saying they were hungry.>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: <Were they fighting it this entire time...?>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: Pwie... Are you all right?
texts.speaker: Ishmael

texts.text: Oh...
texts.speaker: Pwie

texts.text: Pwie stared blankly at the wet pieces of Wriggley dangling between their fingers as if they'd just come back to their senses.
As though looking back at what they had done and finding regret waiting there.
The customer ate the cocoon! Now we can finish making a garment out of the Golden Hide.
texts.speaker: Nurturer

texts.text: I... I thought I was the one who wouldn't hurt Wriggley.
texts.speaker: Pwie

texts.text: I never wanted to...
texts.speaker: Pwie

texts.text: ... but everything turned red. I was so hungry... and so lonely...
texts.speaker: Pwie

texts.text: ... I'll never see Wriggley again, will I?
texts.speaker: Pwie

texts.text: ... Pwie, should you wish it... We could scour this place for another cocoon identical in form to Wriggley. Yet...
texts.speaker: Yi Sang

texts.text: It would not be Wriggley... but merely another cocoon.
texts.speaker: Yi Sang

texts.text: There... Good to go. The Golden Hide garment is sewn~ Hee hee. Once the Floor Manager gives it a final inspection, it'll finally be completed.
texts.speaker: Nurturer
